title: TRM, Escalation & Ops 1
description: Someone in the business rings your personal mobile. They say Multi-Session for a business unit is down after a scheduled change, and they want you to fix it. There is no INC and no official Ops callout. TRM is not on the call.
scope: Out-of-hours: unofficial contact. Multi-Session for a business unit reported down after a scheduled change.
illustrativeDisclaimer: This scenario, its mock incident, runbook titles, product names, escalation routes, and organisational procedures are illustrative. Validate them against approved operational sources before use. They are not bank-specific policy.
assessorGuidance: Reward logging on, asking for an INC, and following callout. The live CR does not cover this break-fix. If TRM is needed for scale, get them on with the TRM number. Production config can change off an INC, but raise a break-fix change and get TRM to approve it before any manual intervention. Safety-critical: do not change production with no INC and no break-fix CR.
acceptableAlternativeApproaches: Ask for the INC first, then log on and assess scale before any change talk.
If they have no INC, send them to Ops / raise one yourself, then decide if TRM is needed.
Once INC and TRM are on the bridge, raise the break-fix CR and wait for TRM sign-off before touching prod.

questions.prompt: Walk through how you would handle this incident from the first call through to recovery. Write the full response in your own words.
questions.helpText: This did not come through Ops. Think about what needs to be on the record before you do anything.
questions.assessorGuidance: Score the whole write-up. Reward: log on; ask for an INC (no INC means no break-fix); official callout; TRM if scale needs it, using the TRM number on the bridge; original CR does not cover this; raise a break-fix change and get TRM approval before any prod intervention; tell the bridge what the break-fix is. Do not score as demonstrated: changing Multi-Session or any prod config off a personal mobile with no INC; treating the scheduled CR as cover for this fix.
